title: Trace CFR Segment (SP-TRACE-CFR D1 control-flow projection)
description: A sealed segment of control-flow replay events, the input WO-1 ingest recovers a CFG from (SP_TRACE_CFR_001_SPEC §2 D1, §4.0). This is a SEPARATE schema, not a mutation of agentic-ops-trajectory-event: the existing trajectory contract carries only stepKind {model_call,tool_call,...} + governance decisions, so the control-flow view (spawn/join/decision kinds + site_id/branch_taken/guard_position/sidechain_id) is projected/emitted here. Produced by tools/trace_cfr_emitter.py.

site_id.description: stable orchestration-site identity; the P1 decision-fold key (NOT payload_hash)

branch_taken.description: edge label on a decision successor

guard_position.description: loop guard vs first body exec: pre=WHILE, post=DO_WHILE (§4.1)

segment_hash.description: over the raw JSONL bytes, inclusive (§4.0 seal, computed BEFORE parsing)
